addons.title: Usage limits
addons.about: Your Claude Code and Codex subscription limits in the Herdr status bar, always in view: every limit window each one reports (5-hour, weekly, per-model weekly such as Fable), with a bar, a pace tick, the percent used and, when it gets tight, the time to reset. Hover it for the details and to choose which providers and windows show.
addons.author: nozikov

addons.title: Claude usage
addons.about: How much of your Claude limits your agents are using, and when they'll run out. A popup shows the account's 5-hour and weekly use as colored bars with their reset times and a forecast ("At this pace, runs out at 5:24 pm"), today's estimated cost across every Claude Code session on the computer next to a 7-day bar chart, and each Claude Code agent in Herdr with its session's tokens and cost.
addons.author: cunderw

addons.title: Insights
addons.about: A native Herdr dashboard for token usage across Pi, Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Antigravity. It reads existing local session data, shows model rankings and activity, and opens in its own tab from an Insights button beside the native tabs.
addons.author: GaganSD

addons.title: Skill Ledger
addons.about: A side panel that shows which skills and MCP servers a person really uses, counted from the local logs of Claude Code and Pi. Two tabs (Skills, MCP) and a period picker sit above ranked lists that fold open and shut.
addons.author: felixfisher

addons.title: Wrapped
addons.about: An overlay that shows a person their Claude Code stats as a card to share. One big token number, what it would have cost, how they worked, the most agents they had going at once, how long their agents waited for them, a swear jar, and a dry line picked by their own numbers.
addons.author: adamentwistle

addons.title: Agent sessions
addons.about: A popup that finds any past Claude Code or Codex session, across every project, by its title, folder or what was said in it. It previews the selected session's last exchanges and brings it back in a new tab in its own folder, forks it into a new session, or goes to it when it is still running in a Herdr terminal.
addons.author: cunderw

addons.title: Revive
addons.about: Revive brings back the coding agent a Herdr terminal lost to a reboot or a herdr-core restart, in the same pane, with the same session and flags. It also forks the focused agent's conversation into a new session beside it.
addons.author: dmazlum

addons.title: Reopen closed tab
addons.about: Cmd+Shift+T for the Herdr desktop app, like a browser's: it brings back the tab you closed last, where it was in its space, with its name and its panes in their folders, and agents (Claude Code, Codex) pick up their last conversation there. Press again for the close before that.
addons.author: mustafaTokmak

addons.title: Claude tab name
addons.group: See what every agent is doing
addons.about: A tab and its Claude Code session keep the same name: /rename in Claude renames the tab, and F2 renames both.
addons.author: iml885203

addons.title: Recap
addons.group: See what every agent is doing
addons.about: Come back to a dozen agents and know in seconds which ones need you. Recap lists every agent on every machine Herdr is connected to, grouped by whose move it is, each with a one-line recap of where it got to, written in the background while you were away.
addons.author: mrolafsson

addons.title: Over9k Switcher
addons.group: See what every agent is doing
addons.about: Jump between agents the way you switch apps. Ctrl+Tab lists every agent on every space and computer, most recent first, with its status.
addons.author: herunan

addons.title: Over9k Timeline
addons.about: See exactly what happened, prompt by prompt. The Timeline lists the conversation you're in, newest first: how long the agent worked on each prompt, when it finished, the tokens it wrote, the files it changed and the commands it ran.
addons.author: herunan

addons.title: Prompt History
addons.about: A panel that shows every prompt you gave a Claude Code agent in its current session, and what it answered, as a column of cards. The newest card sits at the bottom and the list follows it like a terminal.
addons.author: ReyArlena

addons.title: Prompt Jump
addons.about: A panel beside the terminals that lists, oldest first, the prompts the person typed into the focused Claude Code, Codex or omp session. Clicking one scrolls that agent's terminal so the prompt is in view.
addons.author: doominkim

addons.title: Redpen
addons.about: Comment on Claude Code's latest reply, block by block, and send all the comments back as one message. Press a key and the reply opens in a pane beside Claude, split into paragraphs, list items, code blocks and tables.
addons.author: imutaroh

addons.title: Fleece
addons.about: Fleece pulls things out of a Claude Code or Codex agent's answers. A dock pane next to the agent lists the files it edited, plus the code, commands, paths and links from its last few turns.
addons.author: dmazlum

addons.title: Claude goal
addons.about: Write the next /goal for the Claude Code session you're in, with one key.
addons.author: iml885203

addons.title: Agent review
addons.about: A window that shows what an agent (Claude Code, Codex, any agent running in a Herdr terminal) changed in its repo since you last looked. On the left is a list of the agents in the space; on the right, the picked agent's diff.
addons.author: jkuepker

addons.title: Walkthrough
addons.about: A dialog (or pane) that turns the diff of the focused terminal's repository into a guided reading: Claude groups related hunks into steps, orders them so each builds on the last, and explains what each step changes, with the step's code under the explanation. A contents column lists the steps; everything no step covers is listed at the end.
addons.author: dmazlum

addons.title: Tourist
addons.about: A pane where Claude or Codex gives you a guided tour of code: your branch's changes, the last commit, the whole repo, or a feature you describe. The agent picks the stops and their order.
addons.author: CodeyPacker

addons.title: Session changes
addons.about: See what a Claude Code session changed across its repos, from a summary down to the diff.
addons.author: iml885203

addons.title: Arena
addons.about: Arena hands one task to several coding agents at once, each in its own git worktree, then lays their results out as cards: status, latest answer, +ins −del · N files and time. You keep the best lane, or fuse the strongest ones into a new result.
addons.author: dmazlum

addons.title: Automations
addons.about: Scheduled agent prompts, as a side panel next to Files and Changes. A prompt, a cron line and a repo: every weekday at 9:00 an agent starts in a fresh worktree and works.
addons.author: DnzzL
addons.needs: the herdr-automations CLI from its repo

addons.title: Over9k To-do
addons.about: Agentic to-do lists, one per project, that your agents keep for you. Ask for something and it's on the list; when the agent finishes, it's ticked.
addons.author: herunan

addons.title: Desk
addons.about: A panel on the right of the window for the agent you're on: the questions it is waiting on you for, each with an answer box and its recommendation; the worklist it is working through; one-click prompt buttons; a notes area for your own ideas about that agent; and, for Claude Code agents, how full its context is. Agents post with a tiny desk shell command that prints ok, so it costs them almost no tokens; your answers go back as one typed prompt, so nothing polls.
addons.author: CMehlstaeubler

addons.title: Herd
addons.about: A side panel, next to Files and Changes, that shows everything the Claude Code session in view has started. A round map shows the session in the middle and its workers on an orbit.
addons.author: adamentwistle

addons.title: Float Space
addons.about: A floating scratch window over whatever Herdr shows: terminal tabs of its own and up to five named notes shared by every space. Ctrl+Shift+Space shows it in any layout without changing that layout, and hides it again with its shells and their programs still running, returning the keyboard to the pane underneath.
addons.author: thuanlm215

addons.title: Recall
addons.about: Recall is recent + fuzzy. One key lists every space, tab, pane and agent you've been in, most recently focused first, and opens on the one you were in just before this one, so Enter takes you back.
addons.author: shihyuho

addons.title: Jump
addons.about: A popup that lists every space with its tabs and jumps to one when you type its letter. tmux's prefix+w with vimium's hints, in place of the built-in picker.
addons.author: CodeyPacker

addons.title: Find in Files
addons.about: A key opens a dialog over the window, like JetBrains' Find in Files. The person types text.
addons.author: napalmpapalam

addons.title: Kiosk
addons.about: A fuzzy finder for your Git repositories and their branches, opened in a large popup over the window. Type to filter, press Enter or click, and kiosk opens the repository as a space, or the branch in its own worktree and space, making the worktree and the branch if they don't exist yet.
addons.author: thomasschafer

addons.title: Open with
addons.about: Cmd+Shift+O opens a small picker at the top of the window that opens the focused pane's folder in a code editor installed on this computer. It finds your editors by itself (Cursor, VS Code, Zed, Windsurf, Antigravity, Kiro, Sublime Text, the JetBrains IDEs, Xcode and more), puts the last one you used first, and opens Neovim, Helix or Vim in a split beside the pane.
addons.author: jlopezlira

addons.title: SSH hosts
addons.about: An SSH row in the sidebar that opens a searchable list of the hosts in your ~/.ssh/config, grouped by the comments in that file. Each host opens an SSH terminal or a two-pane SFTP browser (this computer on the left, the server on the right, FileZilla style) with a transfer queue.
addons.author: thebends2k

addons.title: Run
addons.about: A popup that runs the processes a repo declares (dev server, API, workers) as background herdr-core terminals and lets you start, stop, restart and peek at them with single keys. The mprocs idea, with letter hints instead of a list.
addons.author: CodeyPacker

addons.title: run-scripts
addons.about: A small run control for JavaScript projects, in the style of Android Studio. It shows the package manager icon, the chosen script name and a down chevron, then a play button.
addons.author: cybertron288

addons.title: Greenflagged
addons.about: A dependency tree viewer for Herdr. It follows the terminal you're working in and shows the project's dependency tree for npm, Python, Rust, Go, Java and Kotlin, read from its manifest and lockfile.
addons.author: greenflagged

addons.title: GitHub
addons.about: Your pull requests in one popup, sorted by whose move it is: yours, the ones waiting on your review, and this repo's. Open one to see whether it can merge and why not, with its failing checks, reviews and conversation; merge it, auto-merge it or send it through the merge queue, or flip it between draft and ready.
addons.author: mrolafsson

addons.title: Markdown panel
addons.about: The plans, notes and reviews your agents write, in a window over any layout: formatted, and edited where they read. Double-click a paragraph, a list or a heading to edit just that block while the rest stays formatted; a table opens as a grid of cells.
addons.author: jlopezlira

addons.title: herdr-md
addons.about: A markdown file rendered natively in a Herdr pane (real heading sizes, theme colors, tables, images, typeset math, Mermaid diagrams) that a coding agent can drive from the shell: it highlights blocks, attaches notes and glides the view to them, and reads back what the person selected.
addons.author: ryanthedev

addons.title: Tab notes
addons.about: A notes panel that follows the tab you're looking at. Each tab gets its own markdown note: what the agent in it is doing, what's left, what you decided.
addons.author: ozcberkay

addons.title: Blueprint
addons.about: A pane (or tab-bar side panel) that draws what the tab's coding agent is building. The agent writes Mermaid flowcharts into Blueprint's data folder; Blueprint lays them out on a dotted canvas, marks finished boxes with a check and work in progress in yellow, and turns a click on a box into a change request typed into that agent's terminal.
addons.author: chappse6

addons.title: Vitals
addons.about: How the machine your agents run on is doing, live, in a window that stays beside your work. Its CPU as a graphic equalizer, a band a core lit green, yellow then red with peaks that hold and fall, memory, load and network as meters, and its disks, with a word on how it's doing: OK, or WARN and HOT and why.
addons.author: mrolafsson

addons.title: PageMe
addons.about: A panel and a small daemon. When an agent is blocked, the person gets a Telegram message with its question and a button per option, and answers from their phone.
addons.author: adamentwistle

addons.title: herdr-pets
addons.about: A strip along the bottom of the window where every running agent is a small pixel creature that roams the whole row. Color and motion show each agent's status, so a blocked agent is easy to spot without reading the sidebar.
addons.author: Aryan1092raj

addons.title: Lichess
addons.about: A side panel that brings Lichess into Herdr: the puzzle of the day, Lichess TV with live moves, and your own games, from finding an opponent to stepping through what you played. Boards look like Lichess's brown board, with Lichess's pieces and arrows.
addons.author: Ghamza-Jd

addons.title: Jumpy Critter
addons.about: A one-button game in a dialog over the window. A small pixel character flaps through gaps between stacks of terminal windows, scrolling right to left, while your agents work.
addons.author: adamentwistle

addons.title: Crawlspace
addons.about: A first-person shooter in a dialog over the window, to play while agents work. You walk grid-based corridors under a server room and shoot bugs across three levels, ending at a boss.
addons.author: adamentwistle
